name: kb_258_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: DeploymentCondition describes the state of a deployment at a certain point.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

lastUpdateTime.description: The last time this condition was updated.

message.description: A human readable message indicating details about the transition.

reason.description: The reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

description:
The deployment condition is of type **Available** and its current status is **True**. The condition transitioned to this status at **2024-05-10T14:23:45Z**, and the most recent update was recorded at **2024-05-10T15:00:00Z**.

The transition was triggered because a new replica set became available, identified by the reason **NewReplicaSetAvailable**. A human‑readable message accompanying the update states: “Deployment is successfully rolled out.”
